column4: RECOIL rejects 6-plane AMOS sprite banks. 32 objects 64x63x6 parse exactly to EOF; 6 planes with a 32-entry palette = Extra Half-Brite (Amiga HRM, file named EHB64). Output reviewed: regular 64-colour bar test pattern.

RECOIL segfaults on this AmIc icon bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 10 icons (16x16 and 32x19, 4 planes) parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: clean icons (arrows, joysticks, GO!, LIVES, NAME buttons).

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 18 sprites, 4 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: coherent monster/explosion animation frames.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 9 bobs 48-80 px wide, 4 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: 9 clean frames of a cartoon character.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 12 sprites, 4 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: green and red bug sprites in 4 orientations.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 16 sprites 16x17, 4 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: pac-man eater frames and walking figure. Byte-identical to Man_bobs.abk.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 25 bobs 64x78, 5 planes (32-colour palette), parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: smooth cowboy shooting/falling animation.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 16 sprites 16x17, 4 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: same image as Eater.abk (byte-identical file).

RECOIL rejects this bank because object 6 is an empty slot (width, height and depth 0), which AMOS allows. Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 16 objects (one empty), 4 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: digitised faces, cone, digits 1-10.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 39 objects of mixed depth 1-4, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: mouse pointers, AMOS logo and fill patterns.

RECOIL segfaults on this AMOS bank (signal 11). Layout per alvyn.sourceforge.net amos_file_formats: 27 objects, 4 and 5 planes, parse exactly to EOF, then 32 0RGB palette words. Output reviewed: 7 all-zero 16x5 objects (blank), then coloured Tetris pieces.

RECOIL rejects HP 48 directory objects. HP 48 FAQ ch. 8: prolog 02A96, 7FF libs, entries name+object; 7 GROBs 131x64 whose length fields equal 15+pixels, last ends at EOF. Drawn side by side like an AMOS bank. Output reviewed: castle, road, face, Forgotten Realms, Enterprise, Dynamix, Coca-Cola logos.

RECOIL rejects HP 48 directory objects. HP 48 FAQ ch. 8: prolog 02A96, entries HYDRA etc.; 6 GROBs 50x60 with consistent length fields (programs between them skipped), last ends exactly at EOF. Drawn side by side. Output reviewed: 6 clean monster cards.

RECOIL rejects HP 48 program objects. HP 48 FAQ ch. 8: prolog 02D9D, a ROM pointer, one GROB 131x128 with consistent length field, rest of program ends with 0312B at EOF. Output reviewed: The Rescuers title and two faces.
